item.name: Gray-Water_Pump
item.description: Pump that moves shower water into the camp gray-water system.
item.readyBeforeUse: The pump is available and removes water from the shower basin.
item.readyForNextPerson: The pump is off after the shower basin is empty. No hose or connection leaks.
item.ifNotReady: Close the shower, display 🔧 Out_of_Service_Sign, and tell the Dominatrix.
